name: LuxeBeauty Returns — Full App + Platform
narrative:
Claire Dubois, a non-technical VP of Operations, opens her Monday console and sees refunds have tripled — ~$180K a week against a normal $60K — driven by three skincare products all running 30% return rates. She asks one question: why do I have so many returns?

The platform answers it: Genie traces the spike to a single bad production lot, a document search surfaces the manufacturing incident behind it, and an ML classifier flags which affected customers are high-value so the response can be tiered — premium buyers get a bigger apology, everyone else a standard one. Three questions, one resolved queue.
